placements.title: Formal Asynchronous Job and Interaction Contracts
placements.frame: What contracts and protocols govern asynchronous dispatch, polling, and interaction lifecycles?

placements.title: Asynchronous Remember Operations Guarantee Immediate Receipt and Resilient Retrieval
placements.frame: How does the async job contract decouple immediate dispatch from extraction while preventing lost work?
placements.why: Wynn and Xena ratify the async remember job contract ensuring fast receipts, polling or piggybacking options, and protection against dropped receipts.
